mapper.insert: insert into social_like_record (from_user_id, to_user_id, action_type, matched, created_at) values (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{actionType}, #{matched}, now())
mapper.update: update social_like_record set matched = 'Y' where action_type = 'LIKE' and ((from_user_id = #{userA} and to_user_id = #{userB}) or (from_user_id = #{userB} and to_user_id = #{userA}))
mapper.insert: insert into social_match_record (user_a, user_b, match_status, created_at) values (#{userA}, #{userB}, 'ACTIVE', now())
mapper.select: select p.profile_id, p.user_id, p.nickname, p.gender, p.city_code, p.profession, p.relationship_goal, p.avatar_url, p.bio, p.album_count, p.real_verified, p.profile_status, p.remark, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at from social_user_profile p inner join ( select to_user_id, max(created_at) as latest_time from social_like_record where from_user_id = #{userId} and action_type = 'LIKE' group by to_user_id ) latest on latest.to_user_id = p.user_id where p.profile_status = 'A' order by latest.latest_time desc

select p.profile_id, p.user_id, p.nickname, p.gender, p.city_code, p.profession, p.relationship_goal, p.avatar_url, p.bio, p.album_count, p.real_verified, p.profile_status, p.remark, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at from social_user_profile p inner join social_match_record m on ((m.user_a = #{userId} and m.user_b = p.user_id) or (m.user_b = #{userId} and m.user_a = p.user_id)) where p.profile_status = 'A' and m.match_status = 'ACTIVE' order by m.created_at desc
select distinct to_user_id from social_like_record where from_user_id = #{userId} and action_type = 'LIKE'
